name: directory_create
title: Create Directory
description: Creates an allowlisted directory on an explicitly selected HHC client after host-policy admission.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory to create on the selected client.

parents.description: Create missing parent directories as needed.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id.

job_id.description: Server job handle for this execution.

created.description: False when the directory already existed.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
